==Dialogue==
Gyala Hatchery:
:''"I will show mercy to our enemies by killing them quickly, but will offer them no quarter!"''

Gyala Hatchery outpost:
:''"Time is of the essence, but we cannot let our guard down; this is an opportune moment for the [[Kurzick]]s to attack. They are steadily advancing on our location."''

:''"What can I help you with?"''

:'''⇒ Remind me of the current situation.'''
::''"Your recent activities such as your participation in the [[Fort Aspenwood]] assault have gained you [[Luxon]] trust. You were sent on an important mission to recover the [[Stolen Eggs|stolen turtle eggs]]. Without them, many of the war efforts would be in vain. Now you must escort the young to the hatchery."''

::'''⇒ Let's talk about something else.'''

:'''⇒ What is going on at the Gyala Hatchery?'''
::''"We are aware of [[Shiro]]'s defeat and have once again returned our forces to the war with the Kurzicks. The [[Young Turtle|siege turtle hatchlings]] must be brought home to be trained and outfitted for the long fight ahead. It is up to you and your party to protect them as they make their perilous journey across the sea that was."''

::'''⇒ Let's talk about something else.'''

:'''⇒ What can you tell me about this mission?'''
::''"1. Use [[Siege Turtle|siege turtles]] to target key spots and bombard the Kurzicks."''

::''"2. Keep the [[Juggernaut]]s away from the turtles, otherwise they will flip them on their backs and render them helpless."''

::''"3. The juggernauts {{sic}} are prone to [[hex]]es and [[condition]]s, but brute force works against them as well."''

::''"4. Protect the turtle hatchlings. Without them the war is lost."''

::'''⇒ Let's talk about something else.'''

:'''⇒ Replay the mission cinematic.'''

:'''× I'll be on my way.'''
